lines.t: Let the trumpet be blown loudly!
Let the call to repentance go out!
Behold — The Trumpet Call of God!
Come, all nations, to the ensign raised high!
A standard lifted — the sleepers wake,
The light shines bright — the hearts shall quake.
A banner waving, the glory unfurls,
The King of Heaven calling all the world!
From Zion’s hill the trumpet sounds,
The Word of YahuShua spreads all around.
A warning, a call, a beacon bright,
To draw the faithful into His light.
Be a Part of The Trumpet Call!
Hear the Word, the Banner for all!
Step forward, beloved, take your stand,
Join the call across the land!
YahuShua-YAHUWAH reigns on high,
The trumpet sounds — redemption nigh!
The nations stir, the plumb line falls,
The righteous rise as judgment calls.
A bright lamppost, a shining flame,
The Trumpet Call proclaims His Name!

Thus says The Lord Beloved, this Word, even every Volume to every Letter, is the Word of My glory, which I have put forth once again... A testament of My love and sacrifice, the announcement of My coming, a proclamation of truth, revelation of who I really am!... The Trumpet Call of God, so all those called and chosen may hear and come to Me in their proper time and season.

Behold, it is also a strong correction for all those who have taken to themselves MY name and MY Word, to pollute it, a plumb line for this wicked generation! For this Word is a waving banner, an ensign to all nations!... A trumpet of alarm and war, the sound of recompense and judgment, which shall soon fall upon every nation!
For I AM WHO I AM!...
The Only Begotten of The Father!
The One True God and Savior!
The Mashiach!...
YahuShua -YAHUWAH!
Be a Part of The Trumpet Call!
Hear the Word, the Banner for all!
Step forward, beloved, take your stand,
Join the call across the land!
YahuShua -YAHUWAH reigns on high,
The trumpet sounds — redemption nigh!
[Outro – Harp Fades, Thunder Rolls, Angelic Whisper]
“Come… take your place… in the Trumpet Call…”
“For behold… the King comes…”
